name: Potion of Healing
description: As a Bonus Action, you can drink this potion or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

name: Greater Potion of Healing
description: As a Bonus Action, you can drink this potion or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature regains 4d4 + 4 Hit Points.

name: Superior Potion of Healing
description: As a Bonus Action, you can drink this potion or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature regains 8d4 + 8 Hit Points.

name: Supreme Potion of Healing
description: As a Bonus Action, you can drink this potion or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature regains 10d4 + 20 Hit Points.
